name.zh-Hant: 維多利亞瀑布（莫西奧圖尼亞）
name.zh-Hans: 维多利亚瀑布（莫西奥图尼亚）

airspace.zh: 辛巴威的無人機法規（2018年第271號法規）沒有免申請的重量下限：遊客帶無人機入境，須事先取得民航局CAAZ的臨時進口許可，否則會在機場被扣留；飛行還需遙控飛行員執照，高度不超過120公尺，並與人、建物和道路保持30公尺。尚比亞一側另有規定。實際飛行前請先確認最新規定。
airspace.en: Zimbabwe's drone rules (Statutory Instrument 271 of 2018) have no weight below which you may fly without permission: visitors need prior import clearance from the CAAZ or the drone is held at the airport, flights need a remote pilot licence, height is limited to 120 m, and drones must keep 30 m from people, buildings and roads. Zambia has its own rules. Check the current rules before any real flight.

island.note: Island on the lip of the falls; Devil's Pool (S 17°55.458 E 25°51.231)

bridge.note: Railway and road bridge over the Second Gorge (17°55′42″S 25°51′26″E)

title.zh-Hant: 傳教士、鐵橋與兩國的瀑布
title.en: A Missionary, a Bridge and a Shared Waterfall

tagline.zh-Hant: 1855年李文斯頓看見瀑布、1905年的鐵橋與北羅德西亞的首府，到1989年的世界遺產
tagline.en: Livingstone's 1855 sighting, the 1905 bridge and a colonial capital, to World Heritage in 1989

zh: 維多利亞瀑布位在尚比亞與辛巴威的邊界上，
尚比西河在這裡，一口氣落進深谷。
en: Victoria Falls lie on the border of Zambia and Zimbabwe,
where the Zambezi plunges in one drop into a gorge.

zh: 1855年11月16日，蘇格蘭傳教士李文斯頓，
從河中的一座小島，第一次看見這座瀑布。
en: On 16 November 1855 the Scottish missionary David Livingstone
first saw the falls from an island in the river.

zh: 他以維多利亞女王的名字，為瀑布命名；
他站過的小島，後來就叫做李文斯頓島。
en: He named the falls after Queen Victoria;
the island he stood on became Livingstone Island.

zh: 1860年，他和植物學家約翰・柯克一起回來，
仔細地研究這座瀑布。
en: In 1860 he came back with the naturalist John Kirk
to study the falls in detail.

zh: 北岸的利文斯頓，在1905年建城，
1911到1935年，是北羅德西亞的首府。
en: Livingstone, on the north bank, was founded in 1905,
and from 1911 to 1935 it was the capital of Northern Rhodesia.

zh: 1935年，首府遷到路沙卡；
2022年，利文斯頓約有十七萬七千人。
en: In 1935 the capital moved to Lusaka;
in 2022 Livingstone had about 177,000 people.

zh: 1904年，鐵路通到瀑布南岸，
橫跨峽谷的大橋，也在這一年動工。
en: In 1904 the railway reached the southern side of the falls,
and work began on a bridge across the gorge.

zh: 鋼材在英國達靈頓預製，運到莫三比克的貝拉，
再用火車載到瀑布。
en: Its steel was prefabricated in Darlington, England, shipped to Beira in Mozambique
and brought to the falls by train.

zh: 塞西爾・羅德斯要火車經過時能沾到瀑布的水霧，
但他自己從沒來過，也沒看到大橋動工。
en: Cecil Rhodes wanted passing trains to catch the spray of the falls,
but he never visited them and died before work began.

zh: 1905年9月12日，大橋由喬治・達爾文爵士啟用；
它長一百九十八公尺，高出低水位的河面一百二十八公尺。
en: On 12 September 1905 Sir George Darwin opened the bridge;
it is 198 m long and 128 m above the low-water level of the river.

zh: 協助計算應力的工程師拉爾夫・弗里曼，
後來成為雪梨港灣大橋的主要設計者。
en: Ralph Freeman, who helped with its stress calculations,
later became principal designer of the Sydney Harbour Bridge.

zh: 1975年，各方在停在橋上的火車車廂裡和談，
談了九個半小時，沒有結果。
en: In 1975 peace talks were held in a train carriage parked on the bridge;
they lasted nine and a half hours and failed.

zh: 1989年，這裡以「莫西奧圖尼亞」與「維多利亞瀑布」
兩個名字，一起列入世界遺產。
en: In 1989 the falls became World Heritage
under both names, Mosi-oa-Tunya and Victoria Falls.

zh: 辛巴威這一側的維多利亞瀑布鎮，1901年開始有人定居，
2020年12月9日升格為市。
en: On the Zimbabwean side, the town of Victoria Falls was settled from 1901
and became a city on 9 December 2020.

zh: 從傳教士的紀錄、跨過峽谷的鐵橋，
到兩國共有的世界遺產，這裡一直是交會的地方。
en: From a missionary's record and a bridge over the gorge
to World Heritage shared by two countries, this has always been a meeting place.

tagline.zh-Hant: 洛齊語與東加語的名字、魔鬼泳池、大橋上的高空彈跳，與兩岸的雙子城
tagline.en: Lozi and Tonga names, the Devil's Pool, bungee from the bridge, and twin towns on two banks

zh: 洛齊語叫它「莫西奧圖尼亞」，
意思是「會打雷的煙」。
en: In Lozi it is Mosi-oa-Tunya,
"the smoke that thunders".

zh: 東加人叫它「順古那穆提提瑪」，
意思是「沸騰的水」。
en: The Tonga call it Shungu Namutitima,
"boiling water".

zh: 李文斯頓也記下了更早的名字「塞翁戈」與「瓊威」，
意思是「彩虹的所在」。
en: Livingstone also recorded the older names Seongo and Chongwe,
meaning "the place of the rainbow".

zh: 李文斯頓島西端的「魔鬼泳池」，是天然的無邊際水池，
通常在九月到十二月，才能下水。
en: The Devil's Pool at the western tip of Livingstone Island is a natural infinity pool,
usually open for a swim from September to December.

zh: 1990年代末，每年約有四十萬人來看瀑布；
辛巴威和尚比亞本國的遊客，比外國遊客更多。
en: By the late 1990s almost 400,000 people came every year;
Zimbabwean and Zambian visitors outnumber those from abroad.

zh: 大橋上的高空彈跳，落差一百一十一公尺；
它也是兩國之間唯一的鐵路連結。
en: The bungee jump from the bridge is 111 metres;
the bridge is also the only rail link between the two countries.

zh: 大橋原本叫做「大尚比西橋」，
過橋費在1906年就取消了。
en: It was first called the Great Zambezi Bridge,
and its toll was abolished in 1906.

zh: 一列一百多年的燃煤蒸汽火車，
載著用餐的旅客，開到橋上和尚比亞的邊界。
en: A coal-fired steam train over a hundred years old
carries diners out to the bridge and the Zambian border.

zh: 辛巴威的維多利亞瀑布市，2022年約三萬五千人；
1990年，大象步行街在這裡開幕。
en: Victoria Falls in Zimbabwe had about 35,000 people in 2022;
its Elephant Walk pedestrian street opened in 1990.

zh: 2019年，這裡提供兩百多種冒險活動，
泛舟、獨木舟、騎馬與觀光飛行，都在其中。
en: In 2019 it offered more than 200 adventure activities,
from rafting, kayaking and riding to sightseeing flights.

zh: 尚比亞這一側的利文斯頓，
和辛巴威的維多利亞瀑布市，結為姊妹市。
en: Livingstone on the Zambian side
is twinned with Victoria Falls in Zimbabwe.

zh: 利文斯頓博物館收藏考古、民族與歷史文物，
還有李文斯頓留下的紀念品。
en: The Livingstone Museum holds archaeology, ethnography and history,
along with memorabilia of David Livingstone.

zh: 1941年，利文斯頓接納了一百七十名波蘭難民，
也設立了波蘭的領事據點。
en: In 1941 Livingstone took in 170 Polish refugees,
and a Polish consular post was set up.

zh: 會打雷的煙、彩虹的所在，
不同的名字，說的是同一道瀑布。
en: The smoke that thunders, the place of the rainbow:
different names for the same falls.

tagline.zh-Hant: 水霧滋養的雨林、河馬與象群、峽谷裡的猛禽，與隨季節漲落的河水
tagline.en: Spray-fed rainforest, hippos and elephants, raptors in the gorges, and a river that rises and falls

zh: 瀑布濺起的水霧，
在瀑布周圍養出了一片雨林。
en: The spray of the falls
feeds a rainforest around them.

zh: 林子裡有莢果桃花心木、烏木，
還有象牙椰子與野海棗。
en: It holds pod mahogany and ebony,
ivory palms and wild date palms.

zh: 瀑布上游的河裡，住著河馬與尼羅鱷；
旱季時，象群會從幾個地方渡河。
en: Above the falls the river holds hippos and Nile crocodiles;
in the dry season elephant herds cross it at certain points.

zh: 瀑布上方的河面上，
常見鷺科鳥類、非洲魚鷹與各種水鳥。
en: On the river above the falls
herons, African fish eagles and waterfowl are common.

zh: 這一帶記錄到三十五種猛禽；
塔伊塔隼、黑鵰、遊隼與非洲鵟，都在峽谷裡繁殖。
en: Thirty-five species of raptor are recorded here;
Taita falcons, Verreaux's eagles, peregrines and augur buzzards breed in the gorges.

zh: 瀑布下方有三十九種魚，上方有八十四種，
可見瀑布擋住了魚類的去路。
en: There are 39 fish species below the falls and 84 above,
which shows the falls are a barrier.

zh: 尚比亞的莫西奧圖尼亞國家公園約六十六平方公里，
辛巴威的維多利亞瀑布國家公園約二十三平方公里。
en: Zambia's Mosi-oa-Tunya National Park covers about 66 km²,
Zimbabwe's Victoria Falls National Park about 23.

zh: 公園裡有非洲象、非洲水牛、長頸鹿，
格蘭特斑馬與多種羚羊。
en: The parks hold African elephants, Cape buffalo, giraffes,
Grant's zebras and many kinds of antelope.

zh: 雨季從十一月底到四月初，
洪水季在二到五月，四月水量最大。
en: The rains last from late November to early April;
the flood season runs from February to May, peaking in April.

zh: 平均流量是每秒一千零八十八立方公尺，
水量大的月份，平均可達每秒三千立方公尺。
en: The mean flow is 1,088 cubic metres a second,
and in the highest months it averages 3,000.

zh: 十一月時，月平均只剩每秒約三百立方公尺，
有時一半的岩壁都會乾掉。
en: By November the monthly mean falls to about 300,
and up to half the rock face can run dry.

zh: 2019年雨量特別少，
瀑布的流量降到一百年來最低。
en: In 2019 unusually little rain fell,
and the falls dropped to their lowest flow in a century.

zh: 水霧常常升到四百公尺以上，有時再高一倍，
五十公里外都看得見。
en: The spray usually rises over 400 metres, sometimes twice that,
and can be seen up to 50 km away.

zh: 滿月的夜晚，
水霧裡有時看得見月虹。
en: On a night of full moon
a lunar rainbow can sometimes be seen in the spray.

zh: 水霧、雨林與大河，
讓瀑布兩岸，成了許多生命的家。
en: Spray, rainforest and the great river
make both banks of the falls a home for life.

tagline.zh-Hant: 世界最大的一片落水、深一百零八公尺的第一峽谷、兩億年前的玄武岩，與後退的瀑布
tagline.en: The world's largest sheet of falling water, a 108 m gorge, 200-million-year-old basalt, a retreating fall

zh: 瀑布寬一千七百零八公尺，高一百零八公尺，
形成世界上最大的一片落水。
en: The falls are 1,708 metres wide and 108 metres high,
making the world's largest sheet of falling water.

zh: 從西到東，依序是魔鬼瀑布、主瀑布，
最高的彩虹瀑布，與東瀑布。
en: From west to east come the Devil's Cataract, the Main Falls,
the Rainbow Falls, the highest, and the Eastern Cataract.

zh: 瀑布頂端的河中有兩塊陸地：
靠西岸的瀑布島，與靠中間的李文斯頓島。
en: Two land masses stand on the lip of the falls:
Cataract Island near the western bank and Livingstone Island near the middle.

zh: 整條河一次垂直落入第一峽谷；
峽谷西端深八十公尺，中段深一百零八公尺。
en: The whole river drops in a single plunge into the First Gorge,
80 m deep at its western end and 108 m in the centre.

zh: 所有的河水，
只從一個一百一十公尺寬的缺口流出峽谷。
en: All of that water
leaves the First Gorge through a gap only 110 metres wide.

zh: 之後河道曲折，穿過一道又一道峽谷；
第二峽谷在瀑布南方兩百五十公尺，長約兩公里。
en: Then the river zigzags through gorge after gorge;
the Second Gorge, 250 m south of the falls, is about 2 km long.

zh: 第二峽谷旁的「沸騰鍋」，
是一個寬約一百五十公尺的深潭。
en: Beside the Second Gorge lies the Boiling Pot,
a pool about 150 metres across.

zh: 瀑布南方五公里多的松圭峽谷，
深一百四十公尺，是最深的一段。
en: The Songwe Gorge, more than 5 km south of the falls,
is the deepest, at 140 metres.

zh: 這片玄武岩高原形成於侏羅紀，
大約在兩億年前。
en: This basalt plateau formed in the Jurassic,
about 200 million years ago.

zh: 東西向的峽谷，沿著岩層的裂隙發育；
河水沿著弱帶侵蝕，瀑布就一段段往上游後退。
en: The east–west gorges follow fracture zones in the rock;
eroding along these weak lines, the falls move upstream step by step.

zh: 約兩百萬年前，地殼抬升，擋住了上尚比西河往南的出路，
形成馬卡迪卡迪古湖。
en: About 2 million years ago uplift blocked the upper Zambezi from draining south,
forming Lake Makgadikgadi.

zh: 約兩萬年前，古湖向東溢出，
切出了巴托卡峽谷。
en: About 20,000 years ago the lake overflowed to the east
and cut the Batoka Gorge.

zh: 巴托卡峽谷裡看得到六道峽谷，
也留下了瀑布過去八個位置的痕跡。
en: The Batoka Gorge shows six separate gorges
and eight earlier positions of the falls.

zh: 峽谷裡的水位，
雨季和旱季可以相差二十公尺。
en: The water in the gorges
can rise and fall by 20 metres between wet and dry seasons.

zh: 一層層玄武岩與一道道裂隙，
記錄了瀑布不斷後退的旅程。
en: Layer upon layer of basalt and line upon line of fractures
record the long retreat of the falls.
